Fixed in 14f789c0. Applied exactly the suggested approach:
- Removed `logs`, `exec`, `top` from the command alternation (arbitrary/utilization content that doesn't fit the status-keep `includePatterns`).
- Added negative lookahead for `-o json/yaml/go-template/jsonpath/template/name` so structured-output requests bypass the filter entirely.

Regression coverage in `tests/unit/compression/rtk-new-filters.test.ts`:
- `kubectl skips arbitrary-content commands (logs, exec, top)` — asserts the filter does NOT claim those invocations.
- `kubectl skips structured -o json/yaml output to avoid corrupting it` — covers 4 variants (`-o json`, `-o yaml`, `--output=json`, `-o jsonpath=…`).

Fixed in 8742deba. Applied exactly the suggested approach:
- Removed `api` from the command alternation (it always returns JSON).
- Added `(?!.*--json)` negative lookahead so `gh pr list --json …` and similar invocations bypass the filter.

Regression coverage:
- 2 new inline tests in `gh.json` (`gh api` + `gh pr list --json`) asserting the raw JSON passes through unchanged.
- New `gh skips 'gh api' and --json invocations` test in `tests/unit/compression/rtk-new-filters.test.ts` covering 4 structured-output variants, mirroring the existing kubectl guard.

All 7 tests in `rtk-new-filters.test.ts` pass; `rtk-filter-catalog` and `rtk-verify` suites unchanged and green.

discussion_comments.comment_body:
Fixed in 14f789c0. Used explicit alternation `(?:docker\s+compose|docker-compose)\s+build\b` instead of the suggested `docker-?compose` — `-?` would not match the space-separated v2 form (`docker compose build`), so the explicit alternation covers both variants safely.

Regression coverage: `docker-build matches both v2 (docker compose) and legacy (docker-compose) build` test in `tests/unit/compression/rtk-new-filters.test.ts` asserts all four invocations match: `docker build`, `docker buildx build`, `docker compose build`, `docker-compose build`.
